Alok Ranjan Samal vs State Of Odisha & Another ......... ... on 17
January, 2024
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Crlmc No.3783 of 2023
 Alok Ranjan Samal ......... Petitioner
 Mr. N. Behuria, Advocate
 -Versus-
 State of Odisha & another ......... Opposite Parties
 Mr. P.K. Maharaj, Asc
 Coram:
 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
 Order

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The petitioner has filed this petition under Section-482 Cr.P.C. seeking quashing of the F.I.R. in Dasarathpur P.S. Case No.111, dated 06.07.2023 corresponding to C.T. Special Case No.73 of 2023 for the offence under Section- 376(2)(n) IPC r/w Section-6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge- cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Jajpur.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge- cum-Special Court
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Mr. Sibanarayan Biswal, learned counsel has entered appearance on behalf of opposite party no.2 in Court today by filing Vakalatnama, which is taken on record.
The parties have also filed a joint affidavit, inter alia, stating that they have settled their dispute.
They want to lead their respective life.
So the opposite party no.2 is not willing to continue with this case.
4. On the basis of this settlement terms, the petitioner seeks quashing of the criminal prosecution lodged against him.
The parties have also filed the self-attested copies of their respective Aadhaar Cards to establish their identity being identified by their respective counsels, which are taken on record.
5. This is a case wherein offence U/s.6 of the POCSO Act is alleged against the petitioner.

Whether on the basis of the settlement terms, the High Court, while exercising the jurisdiction under Section-482 Cr.P.C. could quash the F.I.R. where the offence under the POCSO Act is involved has been the point of debate.
Different High Courts have taken conflicting views on the issue.
6. Therefore, Mr. Behuria, learned counsel is appointed as Amicus Curiae to assist this Court on the issue highlighted above.
He would furnish a written submission by the next date of hearing.
